summary: St. Francois County, Missouri lookout listed under MDC; the only datable fact is a 1975-76 road and parking-lot rework. Sources are thin and status is unknown.

facts.status_note: No fetchable source gives the tower's build date, height or current status.

notes_for_editor: Two fetchable sources, and only one concerns the tower: the Central US Lookouts page, which has a single annual-report line. The Wikipedia article is about the mountain. The story is below the 120-word floor because the fetchable sources support no build date, height, staffing or fate. Lead to check: Facebook posts by the Missouri Conservation History and Equipment page (MCC1010) describe the tower in the past tense, as part of the Perryville Forest District, a standard Aermotor LS-40 at 100 ft. They could not be fetched or quoted, so they are not cited. Do not publish until a fetchable source settles the status.
